Au clavier ou à la manette : les flèches: With keyboard or gamepad: arrows move the cursor, Enter (A) picks up the ball then drops it, Escape (B) lets go.
Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Clic sur une bille, puis sur une case li: Click on a ball, then on a free square
Jeu de réflexion sur un plateau de 9 × 9: A puzzle game on a 9 × 9 board: click a ball, then an empty square, to move it along a clear path, and make lines of five balls of the same colour, straight or diagonal. Every move without a line drops three new balls; the longer the line, the more it scores. The game ends when the board is full.
Les lignes comptent dans les quatre dire: Lines count in all four directions, including diagonals; the longer they are, the more they yield. Lines in a row make a combo: ×2, ×3…
Une bille ne passe que par des cases lib: A ball only passes through free squares (not diagonally). The next three colors are shown at the top.
